render_diagram

Renders a mermaid diagram source to an SVG string.

source — the raw fence content (first word selects the family). theme_json — {"font": "...", "fontSize": 14, "fg": "#…", "bg": "#…", "line": "#…", "accent": "#…"} — the bridge maps live CSS custom properties into this so diagrams follow the active theme.

Returns <svg …>…</svg> or a JsValue error the caller shows as a devWarn while restoring the source block (fail-soft contract).

  • @param {string} source
  • @param {string} theme_json
  • @returns {string}
